newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch EU presidency not seeking pact deal Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Dutch EU presidency not seeking pact deal Sunday.

text.p: The Dutch presidency of the European Union said that it was not seeking to cut a deal on the EMU stability pact at an EU finance ministers' dinner on Sunday night.
"The presidency does not intend to strike deals tonight over dinner," a Dutch spokesman said.
The spokesman emphasised that the dinner due to begin at 1900 GMT was only an informal occasion at which the issue was to be discussed
He said Dutch Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm would brief reporters after the dinner at around 2100-2130 GMT
The finance ministers' dinner comes before a summit of EU leaders on Monday and Tuesday, which was supposed to culmimate in agreement of a new treaty setting Europe's course for the next century.

But the meeting looks set to be dominated by a rift that has emerged between France and Germany since the new French government said last week that it wanted more time to study the stability pact, a framework for keeping EU budgets from ballooning in deficit after the planned launch of the new European single currency in January 1999.
